claims.value_definition: Freedom Fire & Safety Ltd registered in England and Wales, company 13589467; Tom Letcher appointed director on the day of incorporation. Sole director since.

Gross marketplace sales on eBay (about £890,000) and Temu (more than £160,000 in its first three months) plus servicing and contracted site work. Gross of refunds and cancellations, VAT-inclusive marketplace receipts. Not statutory turnover; the reconciled figure comes from the accountant.

claims.claim: eBay UK fire extinguisher sellers: 1st of 1,193
claims.value_definition: Sales rank against every seller in the Fire Extinguishers category, GB, in eBay's own listing quality report.
Named runner-up in the eBay UK Business Awards, followed by an invitation to meet eBay's UK leadership in Belfast.

FIRESTORM: filed with effect from 9 August 2024, entered on the UK register 1 November 2024 in the name of Freedom Fire & Safety Ltd, classes 9 and 20. FXL and SKYLINE followed in February and March 2026. A wider portfolio of about twelve names is in use or in application; only registered marks are counted here.

claims.entity: FFSL premises, Pilsworth Industrial Estate, Bury
claims.value_definition: Move from Unit 10 (about 500 square feet, from April 2022) to Unit 19 on the same estate, about three times the floor space, fitted out over six months and occupied from around November 2024.

Gross sales on Temu UK in the first three months of trading with fewer than ten live products, as Temu's first dedicated fire extinguisher seller. Two Firestorm products held first and second place in Temu's Safety & Security best-seller ranking in the period.
Gross eBay sales between the business store launch in January 2024 and the end of May 2024.

claims.claim: First full year of scaled trading: £600,000+
claims.value_definition: More than £500,000 of gross eBay sales plus about £100,000 of servicing and contracted site work.
The first eBay listing, a second-hand 2 kg CO2 extinguisher posted in December 2020 from a personal account, has sold close to 8,000 units and more than £350,000 in gross sales to date.

Minimum first order with the manufacturer met at the National Fire Safety show at the NEC in April 2024; Freedom Fire was the manufacturer's first UK client. Funded by borrowing and trading cash, not equity.
First container of Firestorm-branded extinguishers, several thousand units, landed in the UK on Christmas Eve 2024.

£17,000 of the founder's savings and £5,000 borrowed from family, almost all of it spent on stock ahead of the 2024 store launch. The business has been built without institutional equity investment: savings, family borrowing, trading cash and later working-capital finance.
One second-hand fire extinguisher, bought for next to nothing, refurbished and sold through a Facebook Marketplace listing to a customer who collected it.
About 400 mixed refurbished units supplied to a Bolton fire-training buyer for around £1 each; probably loss-making once time and delivery were counted, and the first proof of volume demand.

A takeaway in Nottingham paid online for a refurbished extinguisher to be sent, which required a carrier willing to take the item and packaging that would pass; the first proof that the business was not limited to collection.

claims.entity: Trading as Freedom Fire, before incorporation
claims.value_definition: Weekly throughput of the refurbishment operation at the back of the family warehouse by 2021, with students employed to clean, refill and prepare stock; the ceiling that made incorporation and new supply necessary.
Placements for learners from Newbridge College, including young people with additional needs, from 2021; one early placement progressed to long-term full-time employment.
Formal T Level industry placements began in September 2025 with support from the Growth Company: three students, each offered a long-term role by June 2026.

eBay (business store since January 2024), Temu (since 2025) and the company's own site. Amazon, OnBuy and a Shopify store were in launch during summer 2026 and are counted as targets until live sales are reported.
